events.summary: Added a serial real-browser harness for the built PWA, production SQLite-WASM and OPFS SAH-pool with no catalog client or worker mocks.
requiredActions: Forge must expose CatalogStatus active slot, catalog version, product count, persistence and install-source fields without test-only alternate authority.
Lumen must render the semantic data-testid and data-* diagnostics documented in e2e/README.md.
Owner must run this harness only after the Forge and Lumen boundaries are integrated.

events.summary: Added production journeys for initial install, reopen, offline reuse, SQLite search order, barcode resolution, Bueno unit evidence, corrupt update rejection and rollback.
requiredActions: Atlas and Helix must preserve explicit proven-unit provenance values consumed by the Bueno formula proof.
Forge must install updates only into the inactive slot and retain the previous slot after hash, schema or integrity failure.
Lumen must keep the active catalog searchable while surfacing the rollback issue code.

events.summary: Added manifest-derived artifact and workflow validation, pinned Knip and dependency-cruiser gates, real browser CI and removed the temporary PR source snapshot.
requiredActions: Owner must integrate Sentinel after runtime and UI agents, then use Knip and dependency-cruiser output to approve the final legacy deletion set.
Do not weaken online-authority, circular-dependency or boundary rules to preserve obsolete code.
Regenerate package-lock only if the pinned analysis tools are later moved from npm exec into devDependencies.

events.summary: Derived browser catalog identity from the production manifest and restored valuable non-API shell, navigation, mobile-overflow, accessibility, manual-calculation and local-BLS coverage without restoring gateway, OFF-account or product-API mocks.
